work_items.title: Replace hand assessment with executable baseline probes
work_items.status_note: MET: status_source=probe-emitted (all 46 rows); proof_command python3 scripts/feature-probes.py --check exits 0 against canonical data/v1-feature-matrix.json. Profile C rows explicitly preview-stage per Sol WS3; every non-pass Profile A/B row has exactly one owning WI (WI-010..WI-017, WI-025). A probe 'pass' is an implementation-presence result (the structural probes found the surface), NOT a behavioral qualification or gate-completion signal; the qualification evidence for each journey is tracked per-WI in this release board and in data/claims-ledger.json.

work_items.title: Reconcile plans, source state, and dogfood state
work_items.status_note: MET: schema landed (origin revision, ahead, behind, provenance_known, dirty, plan status, deployed_version, umbrella, source_tree_converged fail-closed). Dogfood deployed versions recorded via *_DEPLOYED_VERSION env vars in suite.env. Dossier LDAP backend live (dedicated svc-dossier account bound successfully against ldaps://ad.hraedon.com). Cairn content encryption ON via vault:homelab/cairn/content-key#key. Codex plugins (agent-notes, cairn) installed and enabled. Release-time inventory generated by .github/workflows/release.yml on tag push; local operators run agent-suite inventory --json for live inspection. Durable model: data/candidate-inventory.json is release-time generated and gitignored — it is NEVER committed to main (a committed snapshot would be self-stale the moment it is written, because writing it changes the umbrella HEAD it snapshots). The committed, durable proof is the generator (src/agent_suite/inventory.py), its validator tests (tests/test_inventory.py), and the release.yml step that attaches the artifact to the tag; the release-board validator classifies the path as a typed release-time-generated external artifact. Until Gate 2 (release-board WI-2.3) builds immutable wheels, the release-attached inventory and manifest describe a source candidate (locked source revisions checked out and tested), not an immutable wheel/bundle candidate — no wheel reproducibility is claimed.
work_items.proof_command: agent-suite inventory --json --record (writes the gitignored data/candidate-inventory.json; .github/workflows/release.yml attaches it to the tag)

work_items.title: Identity, keys, and protected administration
work_items.status_note: IN PROGRESS. Landed (dossier 65857cf/f3197cb/4ff451d/93a3fc9; regista 3c0e226/fbe37ec/184e037, schema 44 durable one-use challenges): durable public principal lifecycle via the regista public API only; file-custody client-signer exchange with no private key in the browser/ordinary dossier process; genuine second-principal approval (core approver separation, concurrent prepare idempotency); non-Entra step-up bound to a frozen action digest; durable one-use possession/effective challenges (replay rejected); a public ApprovalVerifier; signed effective-receipt metadata with chronology validation (future/predated/naive observed_at rejected); legacy in-process enrollment fail-closed against real regista. proof_command runs in the owner repo (hraedon/dossier) against the existing dossier tests: tests/test_plan015.py (lifecycle/custody/enroll-revoke-rotate, no-private-key, fail-closed), tests/test_signer_flow.py (client-signer exchange, challenge/effective-receipt durability + chronology), tests/test_step_up.py and tests/test_step_up_routes.py (non-Entra step-up, public ApprovalVerifier); tests/test_plan015_postgres.py is the PostgreSQL-backed variant. Private-key assurance is file development mode only (owner-permissioned file custody) -- no HSM/Entra-key or hardware-backed assurance is claimed. Remaining blockers: complete human enrollment/rotation UI; remote and Windows custody and qualification; multi-project repair/reconciliation; Entra/workplace identity and session lifecycle; break-glass (forms currently render not-available/not-implemented); and a clean published/locked regista artifact carrying schema 44. Verified evidence: regista focused 141 passed; dossier full 799 passed / 6 skipped; ruff/mypy green.
